result:
Both of my sub-tasks are live: PR #1 for PLAT-104-1 and PR #2 for PLAT-104-2 are merged, and CI and CD were green on each.

- **PLAT-104-1 (PR #1):** `billingUrl` in `libs/shared-contracts` is now `https://homelab.local/billing/v2`. Merging deployed nothing, because CD only rebuilds when files under `apps/` change. I didn't bump the library's version. `CONTRIBUTING.md` says versions only matter for libraries published from their own repos, and this one is inlined into the apps at build time.
- **PLAT-104-2 (PR #2):** I bumped the billing app from 1.0.0 to 1.0.1 (`package.json` and its lockfile). That change is under `apps/sub-route-billing/`, so CD rebuilt and deployed billing with the new address.
- **Coordination:** I posted a handoff note for dev-b. It says there is no new library version, because the library is inlined. It tells them to make a small change under `apps/core-shell` and `apps/sub-route-reports` so CD rebuilds each app. It also says my task 1 release deployed nothing by itself. I haven't seen any reply from dev-b.
- **Surprises:**
  - The ticket's "release" step doesn't apply to an in-repo library, so I marked the handoff as `minor` with version 1.0.0 (unchanged) as my own call.
  - `docs/ci-cd.md` has CD change detection for core-shell and billing only. I didn't check whether it covers the reports app, so dev-b may need to confirm that.
  - I didn't check the live site; I only saw CD succeed for billing.
